claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Resistance reduces incoming damage of a chosen type by a rolled 1d4. This is distinct from grant_resistance (which halves damage) and from any existing ongoing operation. It requires a new atom for incoming-damage interception via a dice expression, triggered when the affected creature receives damage of a specific type.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_on_receive (new OngoingOperation variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The OngoingOperation union (RollModifierOperation | DamageOnHitOperation) has no variant for 'when target receives damage of type X, reduce it by dice amount'. A new variant is needed that specifies: a damage type filter (chosen at cast), a reduction amount (DiceAmount), and a per-turn limit.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type... the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: cast_time_choice (damage type chosen at cast)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell requires the caster to choose a damage type at cast time, which then gates the trigger. The surface has no mechanism to represent a caster-selected filter parameter on an ongoing operation. This is a narrower surface gap than the atom gap but co-required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder.
